nodes.community_name: CM ChangeOffer order (cart + productOrder) to delete bundles
nodes.rationale: crearCarrito adds dependent product as NO_CHANGE and retries up to MAX_DEPENDENCIAS (10).

nodes.label: NO_ELIMINABLES bundle list
nodes.community_name: CM ChangeOffer order (cart + productOrder) to delete bundles
nodes.rationale: Bundles CM reports enabled but rejects on removal (e.g. 394 Promo 1x1); one rejected option fails whole order.

nodes.norm_label: plu sequence (consultar, aplicar, evidencia, eliminar, verificar)
nodes.rationale: One PLU at a time so evidence and deletion of bundles do not mix.

nodes.label: Tulio RecargaPaquete
nodes.community_name: CM ChangeOffer order (cart + productOrder) to delete bundles
nodes.rationale: Success requires both estado fields '000', not just HTTP 200; timeouts not retried to avoid double recharge.
